goal: Extract cohesive, low-dependency private helper logic from ClassUtils into a new helper class to reduce size/complexity while preserving the public API.

ops.details: Create a new helper class org.apache.commons.lang3.ClassUtilsHelper containing static helper methods: getAllInterfaces(Class<?>, Set<Class<?>>), useFull(int,int,int,int), and walkInterfaces(Set<Class<?>>, Class<?>). The methods are implemented with the same logic as the corresponding private logic moved from ClassUtils, but declared static and package-private so ClassUtils can call them without changing its public API.
Move private static void getAllInterfaces(Class<?> cls, Set<Class<?>> interfacesFound) implementation into ClassUtilsHelper as a static method with identical behavior.
Move private static boolean useFull(int runAheadTarget, int source, int originalLength, int desiredLength) into ClassUtilsHelper as a static method with identical behavior.

Update internal calls in ClassUtils to reference the new helper methods: replace calls to getAllInterfaces(...) with ClassUtilsHelper.getAllInterfaces(...), replace useFull(...) with ClassUtilsHelper.useFull(...), and replace the anonymous-iterator-local walkInterfaces recursion by invoking ClassUtilsHelper.walkInterfaces(addTo, c). Keep all public methods and signatures unchanged.
